   ITEM NO. 1

  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SOUTH GATE CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
  TUESDAY, MARCH 7, 2023

  1. CALL TO ORDER
  The Planning Commission of the City of South Gate met via teleconference and in-person on the
  above date at 7:00 PM, Vice Chairperson Duarte presiding.

  2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE – Commissioner Laborin

  3. ROLL CALL
  Commissioners Present:  Vice Chairperson Duarte, Laborin, Ozaeta and Prieto
  Commissioners Absent:  Chairperson Delgado
  Staff Present:  Meredith T. Elguira, Director of Community Development
  Yalini Siva, Senior Planner
  Norma Hernandez, Assistant Planner
  Jose Montano, Recording Secretary
  Craig Hardwick, City Attorney

  4. REPORT ON POSTING AND MEETING COMPENSATION DISCLOSURE

  5. MINUTES

  MOTION: Commissioner Laborin moved to approve the minutes and Commissioner Ozaeta
  seconded the motion. Motion carried unanimously, with the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Duarte, Laborin, Ozaeta and Prieto
  NOES:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  6. STUDY SESSION

  Yalini Siva, Senior Planner, Norma Hernandez, Assistant Planner, and Craig Hardwick, City Attorney
  presented a Planning study session that informed the Planning Commission of key terms,
  applications, Agenda Bills, Resolutions, Ordinance processes, and California Environmental Quality
  Act (CEQA). We also went over the General Plan, Zoning Code, Specific Plan & other city projects.
  Went over the upcoming projects that will be presented to the Planning Commission in the
  upcoming months. Following, a range of discussions amongst the Planning Commissioners and
  staff.

  Received and file.

  7. AUDIENCE COMMENTS
  None

  8.  CITY STAFF COMMENTS
  Meredith T. Elguira, Director of Community Development, informed the commissioners of the
  importance of this study session because it outlined important information commissioners
  should know and understand.

 9.  PLANNING COMMISSION COMMENTS
  Vice Chairperson Duarte thanked staff for putting this study session for the Planning Commission.

 10. ADJOURNMENT
  The meeting was adjourned at 8:38 PM. The next regular meeting of the Planning Commission is
  scheduled to be held on Tuesday, March 21, 2023, beginning at 6:00 PM.
